canonical_project: Bafoussam smart-city data centre proposal (CAMTEL convention)
notes: Unverified lead: 2021 public social/news snippets report a Bafoussam City Council-CAMTEL convention (non-binding MOU) for a digital-town initiative including hosting at the Zamengoé state data center and a data centre component. No primary confirmation, site or MW found in this run; status unknown (not confirmed planned/construction/operational). 2026-08-12 West-region sweep found no verified data centre in Bafoussam/Dschang/Foumban.
